LESSON: COORDINATES AND GRAPHS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry
Topic 4.1: Coordinates and Graphs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Coordinates and Graphs, part of Geometry in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we draw graphs of straight lines? 2. How do we interpret graphs of straight lines?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Work with peers and locate the point of intersection of the x coordinate and the y- coordinates on a Cartesian plane. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to locate the point of intersection on a Cartesian plane. More time could be allowed for learners with speech difficulties to express their views.

2. Generate a table of values from equation on a straight line, plot and join the points to form a straight line in purposive groups/pairs. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Work with peers and locate the point of intersection of the x coordinate and the y- coordinates on a Cartesian plane. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to locate the point of intersection on a Cartesian plane. More time could be allowed for learners with speech difficulties to express their views.
2. Generate a table of values from equation on a straight line, plot and join the points to form a straight line in purposive groups/pairs. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Coordinates and Graphs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration – as the learner works with peers to locate the point of intersection of straight lines.

● Critical thinking and problem solving - as the learner generates a table of values.
